title: SQuAD 2.0: can the question be answered from the passage?
decision: whether a question can be answered from the given passage (yes) or not (no)

source.name: SQuAD 2.0 (Know What You Don't Know: Unanswerable Questions for SQuAD, arXiv:1806.03822)

notes: 500 answerable (gold yes: `answers.text` not empty) + 500 unanswerable (gold no) questions, sampled per class with random.Random(20261007) (answerable first) after sorting by id. Before sampling, 14 rows were dropped because the same passage and question (case and spacing ignored) occur with both labels, and 7 repeated rows with the same label (first id kept); pools: 5,915 answerable, 5,937 unanswerable. Passages are shared: the 1000 rows use 701 different passages from 35 articles (meta.title). The validation split is the evaluation split with public labels (the card has no test split). Texts are copied unchanged (state.passage = field `context`). Decontamination against the authors' training data (scan of 7 October 2026, 1,546,178 training records): 49 of 1000 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it, and 7 more to restore the balance of the classes; 944 items remain. Decontamination against the training data of the final StartLux-Decision-27B (scan of 10 October 2026, 3,252,020 training records of Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3 and the RL pool): 20 of 944 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it, and 8 more to restore the balance of the classes; 916 items remain.
